svg.text: x86 vs ARM: Register Comparison (CISC vs RISC)
frame base for local variable access
ZF, CF, SF, OF, PF, DF…
link register — holds return address from BL
N, Z, C, V flags + mode bits
• Load-store only: all ops on registers, not memory
Syscall mechanism: x86 → int $0x80 | ARM → swi 0 (r7=syscall#)
Instr length: x86 variable (1-17B) vs ARM fixed (4B)
Return addr: x86 → on stack (esp) | ARM → in r14 (lr)
